views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said Ebos Group is Australasia's largest distributor of medical, pharmaceutical and animal care products, diversified across healthcare and animal care. It noted $522 million animal care revenue up 16% and brands Hawk, Vida Pet, Lipard, and an Animates JV with Pet Barn.
